name: Clear Kayaks Barbados
summary: Guided paddles and rentals in clear-hulled kayaks, so you can see the reef and wrecks under you as you go. Tours leave from Harbour Lights on Carlisle Bay and from Holetown on the west coast, and each ends with a rum punch on the beach.
standouts: Guided tours over three shipwrecks in Carlisle Bay and the coral reefs of Folkestone Marine Park
Rentals at Carlisle Bay and west coast spots including Batts Rock, Paynes Bay, Holetown, Gibbs and Six Mens Bay
Complimentary rum punch on the beach after each tour

trips.title: Carlisle Bay Shipwreck Tour
trips.summary: A guided paddle from Harbour Lights across Carlisle Bay in a clear kayak. You stop first where green and hawksbill turtles are often seen, then cross three shipwrecks lying close to shore while the guide tells how each one sank. The tour ends back on the beach with a rum punch.
highlights: Starts at Harbour Lights, Carlisle Bay
Area where green sea turtles and hawksbill turtles are regularly spotted
Three shipwrecks sunk close to shore, with their history
Complimentary rum punch on the beach
trips.departsFrom: Harbour Lights, Carlisle Bay, Bridgetown, Barbados

trips.checkNotes: Price basis (per person or per booking) not stated. Cancellation policy on the page: contact at least 24 hours before the booking to avoid charges. Departure times only appear inside the Wix booking calendar.

trips.title: Folkestone Marine Park Coral Reef Tour
trips.summary: A west coast paddle in a clear kayak over the coral reefs of Folkestone Marine Park, a protected marine reserve. The tour also passes a small shipwreck before heading back to the beach for a rum punch.
highlights: Paddles over coral reefs in Folkestone Marine Park, a protected marine reserve
Visits a small shipwreck on the west coast
Complimentary rum punch on the beach

trips.title: Private Sunset Tour
trips.summary: An evening paddle in a clear kayak along the Carlisle Bay coast as the sun sets. It leaves from Harbour Lights on Bay Street and finishes on the beach with a rum punch.
highlights: Evening paddle at sunset in Carlisle Bay
Leaves from Harbour Lights, Bay Street
Complimentary rum punch on the beach

trips.title: Double Kayak Rental
trips.summary: Rent a clear double kayak for an hour, two hours or a full day and paddle on your own. Rentals run from Carlisle Bay and several west coast beaches, and kayaks can be dropped off and collected at locations around the island.
highlights: Up to 1 hour, up to 2 hours or a full day
Available at Carlisle Bay and west coast spots including Batts Rock, Paynes Bay, Holetown, Gibbs and Six Mens Bay
Kayaks can be dropped off and picked up at various locations
trips.duration: up to 1 hr, up to 2 hrs or 1 day
trips.departsFrom: Carlisle Bay, or west coast locations including Batts Rock, Paynes Bay, Holetown, Gibbs and Six Mens Bay
trips.checkNotes: Booked by phone (+1 246 238 8470) or the contact form. Prices are per double kayak, not per person.

checkNotes: Footer still reads (c) 2019, but the Wix booking services were updated in October 2025, so the business looks to be trading. The site also sells clear double kayaks (US$1499, can be shipped worldwide), not included as a trip. No WhatsApp link on the site.
